HERO_MARIUS.name: Gaius Marius
HERO_MARIUS.title: Father of the Legion
HERO_MARIUS.playerProblemSolved: Melee waves overwhelm me before my ranged towers can clean them up.
HERO_MARIUS.biography: Marius rebuilt Rome's army from scratch, opening the legions to every citizen regardless of birth. On this field, his presence makes every melee tower fight like a veteran.

passive.description: Every MELEE tower within 5 tiles gains +35% damage.

abilities.name: Marian Formation
abilities.description: The 5 nearest melee towers form ranks for 5s — shared crit chance (every tower in the formation inherits the highest crit% on the team), +75% attack speed, and +30% damage. Net effect: each buffed tower deals roughly 2.28× its normal DPS during the window (1.75 speed × 1.30 damage), so a typical 5-tower formation outputs ~11× a single tower's DPS for 5s.

abilities.name: Capite Censi
abilities.description: Three phantom auxilia rise near Marius for 6s and hurl 6 pila each at enemies within 2.5 tiles. They prioritize bosses and commanders, dealing +50% damage to those leaders. Each throw deals 75% of Marius's basic-hit damage.

bannerCopy: Marius takes the field. The legions reform.
MARIUS reached LEGATUS — Marian Formation locks the line.
MARIUS reached CONSUL — Capite Censi answers the call.
MARIUS reached IMPERATOR — the father of the legion nears apex form.
MARIUS reached DIVUS — the father of the legion at full strength.

HERO_AGRIPPA.name: Marcus Agrippa
HERO_AGRIPPA.title: Admiral of the Fleet
HERO_AGRIPPA.playerProblemSolved: My siege towers spread too thin against high-HP single targets. I need bombardment power.
HERO_AGRIPPA.biography: Agrippa's naval genius delivered Rome the Mediterranean. Under his command, siege towers reach farther, hit harder, and rain mortar shells that scatter the enemy line.

passive.description: Every SIEGE tower within 5 tiles gains +30% damage and +1.0 range.

abilities.name: Pilum Volley
abilities.description: Fires 5 javelins simultaneously at the 5 highest-HP enemies in range. Each javelin deals 90% of Agrippa's basic-attack damage. Total burst: ~4.5× Agrippa's basic damage, focused on the toughest 5 targets on screen — exactly when boss + elite stacks are clogging the lane.

abilities.name: Naval Bombardment
abilities.description: 3 mortar shells drop on random path tiles. Each shell deals 160% of Agrippa's basic-attack damage in a 2-tile splash and stuns survivors for 1.8s. Total burst: 4.8× Agrippa's basic damage across 3 splash zones, plus a 1.8s stun on every enemy caught — pairs well with direct-damage towers ready to capitalize on the stunned window.

bannerCopy: Agrippa commands the line. The volleys begin.
AGRIPPA reached LEGATUS — Pilum Volley cleared for launch.
AGRIPPA reached CONSUL — Naval Bombardment unlocked.
AGRIPPA reached IMPERATOR — the admiral nears apex form.
AGRIPPA reached DIVUS — the admiral at full command.

visual.companionDescription: A small spectral galley orbits Agrippa's tile, one revolution every ~4 seconds.

HERO_AGRICOLA.name: Gnaeus Agricola
HERO_AGRICOLA.title: Governor of the Frontier
HERO_AGRICOLA.playerProblemSolved: I keep forgetting about flyer waves and losing lives to them.
HERO_AGRICOLA.biography: Agricola pacified Rome's British frontier through relentless surveillance and aggressive response. On this field, no flyer goes unnoticed and none goes unpunished.

passive.description: Every tower within 10 tiles of Agricola — including MELEE — can target and attack flyers. All towers also gain +15% damage vs flyers.

abilities.name: Eagle Scout
abilities.description: Every flyer on the map is marked for 3s. Marked flyers take +60% damage from all sources — every tower hitting a marked flyer deals 1.60× damage. On a 5-flyer wave that's a +60% DPS boost across the entire flyer corridor for the 3s window.

abilities.name: Frontier Wall
abilities.description: For 4s, all flyers slow 70% (move at 30% speed) AND every tower gains +25% damage vs. flyers (1.25×). Stacks multiplicatively with Eagle Scout's +60% mark — overlapping both abilities = 2.00× total damage on every flyer for the ~3s overlap window, while they crawl across your kill zone at a third of normal speed.

bannerCopy: Agricola takes the field. The skies are no longer safe.
AGRICOLA reached LEGATUS — Eagle Scout marks every wing.
AGRICOLA reached CONSUL — Frontier Wall slows the air assault.
AGRICOLA reached IMPERATOR — the governor nears apex form.
AGRICOLA reached DIVUS — total air dominance.

visual.companionDescription: A spectral white eagle perches on Agricola's shoulder. Wings shift occasionally.

HERO_SCIPIO.name: Scipio Africanus
HERO_SCIPIO.title: Conqueror of Carthage
HERO_SCIPIO.playerProblemSolved: Bosses and commanders walk through my maze at 80% HP and eat my lives.
HERO_SCIPIO.biography: Scipio studied Carthage for years before he attacked — patient, methodical, without mercy. He has never lost to a boss or commander and does not intend to start.

passive.description: Every tower on the map deals +33% damage against Bosses and Commanders. No radius limit.

abilities.name: Cornu Charge
abilities.description: Pierces the highest-HP boss or commander for 500% of Scipio's basic-attack damage as TRUE damage — ignores every faction resistance, every shield, every boss damping. The reliable priority-target burst Scipio brings to every fight.

abilities.name: Scipio's Brand
abilities.description: Brands every boss and commander on the field for 6s. Marked targets take +30% damage from ALL sources (1.30×), stacking multiplicatively with Scipio's priority-hunting passive and any other MARK debuffs.

bannerCopy: Scipio takes the field. Carthage must fall.
SCIPIO reached LEGATUS — Cornu Charge is ready.
SCIPIO reached CONSUL — Scipio's Brand marks every boss and commander.
SCIPIO reached IMPERATOR — the conqueror nears apex form.
SCIPIO reached DIVUS — the conqueror at full power.

visual.companionDescription: A small war-table with a parchment map sits at Scipio's feet. Sword glints every 2s.

HERO_CAESAR.name: Julius Caesar
HERO_CAESAR.title: Dictator of Rome
HERO_CAESAR.playerProblemSolved: I have a great tower build and I want everything to hit harder — and I want control of the battlefield.
HERO_CAESAR.biography: Caesar did not wait for opportunity — he manufactured it. Under his command, Rome's defenders act faster, hit harder, and leave nothing alive that's already dying.

passive.description: Every tower on the map gains +15% damage and +15% attack speed. Stacks with all other aura towers.

abilities.name: SPQR Decree
abilities.description: Commands every placed combat tower to fire one early bonus attack at its current target. The decree rolls across the formation over roughly 1.5 seconds, preserving the full extra combat round without forcing every projectile and on-hit effect into one frame. The bigger your maze, the bigger the burst.

abilities.name: Pax Romana
abilities.description: Every enemy on the field is slowed 60% for 2 seconds — they crawl at 40% speed during the window. Hits bosses, flyers, and runners alike, so every enemy on screen spends ~2.5× longer in your kill zone for the duration. Buys time for high-damage towers to land more shots before the wave reaches your gate.

bannerCopy: Caesar takes the field. The Rubicon is crossed.
CAESAR reached LEGATUS — SPQR Decree goes out.
CAESAR reached CONSUL — Pax Romana imposed.
CAESAR reached IMPERATOR — the dictator nears apex form.
CAESAR reached DIVUS — the dictator at full power.

visual.companionDescription: Gold sparks arc from Caesar's tile constantly.

HERO_SULLA.name: Lucius Sulla
HERO_SULLA.title: The Fortunate
HERO_SULLA.playerProblemSolved: Enemies keep resisting my damage types and I need a way to punch through.
HERO_SULLA.biography: Sulla was famously lucky — he said so himself, and Rome believed him. On this field his luck translates into pyres and divine wrath: his meteors leave the road burning, every nearby attack carries added flame, and on command every tower's strike becomes pure DIVINE.

passive.description: Every tower within 5.5 tiles keeps its own damage type and adds +22% FIRE damage on each hit.

abilities.name: Meteor Slam
abilities.description: Calls down a burning meteor on the nearest enemy in range, dealing 150% of Sulla's basic-attack damage to the main target, splashing 45% damage in 1.35 tiles, burning everything caught for 3.3s, and leaving BURNING GROUND for 4.4s.

abilities.name: Proscription
abilities.description: For 5s, every tower's damage type is overridden to DIVINE — bypassing every faction resistance. A tower normally hitting at 50% effectiveness (e.g. Physical vs Iron Phalanx, W17) suddenly does full 1.00× damage. Against waves with heavy resists this is effectively a 1.5× to 2× global damage boost for the entire 5s window.

bannerCopy: Sulla lights the flame. Rome does not fall tonight.
SULLA reached LEGATUS — Fortune's Bolt guards the gate.
SULLA reached CONSUL — Proscription overrides all resistance.
SULLA reached IMPERATOR — fortune nears full bloom.
SULLA reached DIVUS — fortune fully awakened.

visual.companionDescription: Six small candle flames orbit Sulla's tile slowly. They flare bright whenever Sulla lands a killing blow.
